items.title: Awesome Rust
items.content_text:
### Applications / System tools

*   [AppachiTech/suvadu (⭐110)](https://github.com/AppachiTech/suvadu) \[[suvadu](https://crates.io/crates/suvadu)] - Zsh and Bash history in a local SQLite database with exit codes, directories and the commands AI coding agents run, plus a read-only MCP server [![CI](https://github.com/AppachiTech/suvadu/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/AppachiTech/suvadu/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Libraries / Data processing

*   [marcomq/mq-bridge (⭐24)](https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge) \[[mq-bridge](https://crates.io/crates/mq-bridge)] - Async ETL and messaging library: config-driven routes move data between brokers (Kafka, NATS, AMQP, MQTT), databases incl. Postgres/MongoDB CDC, Parquet on S3/GCS/Azure, files and HTTP/gRPC, with retry, DLQ and deduplication middleware [![CI](https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

items.title: Awesome Mac
items.content_text:
### Developer Tools / Databases

*   [DBine](https://dbine.com) - Open-source database manager for 130+ SQL and NoSQL databases and cloud services, with notebooks, schema and data compare, and an MCP server. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/addlayer-io/dbine) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### AI Tools / Other Tools

*   [Cove](https://huyanxius.github.io/Cove/) - Open-source native composer, session sidebar and diff viewer for Claude Code and Codex, currently available as an Apple Silicon preview. items.title: Awesome Mqtt
items.content_text:
### Brokers

*   [VelaMQ](https://www.velamq.com/) - Rust-based MQTT broker with clustering, a web console, authentication, topic ACLs, and a SQL rule engine.

### Tools

*   [MQTT Scope (⭐1)](https://github.com/ToRexZ/mqtt-scope) - Desktop MQTT client for Linux, Windows and macOS with a live topic tree, a large-message inspector with diff, and live plots of any JSON field. [Website](https://torexz.github.io/mqtt-scope/).
items.content_html:

items.title: Magictools
items.content_text:
### Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

*   :money\_with\_wings: [Pic2SVG](https://pic2svg.com/) - Raster-to-vector tracing preview for inspecting flat artwork intended for game icons or UI. Free anonymous split preview and enlarged view; downloads require Pro. Images are processed on the server.
items.content_html:
Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

  • 💸 Pic2SVG - Raster-to-vector tracing preview for inspecting flat artwork intended for game icons or UI. Free anonymous split preview and enlarged view; downloads require Pro. Images are processed on the server.

items.title: Awesome Storybook
items.content_text:

### Examples

items.title: Awesome Zsh Plugins
items.content_text:
### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [spotify-now (⭐1)](https://github.com/ericlikedis/spotify-now) - Shows the track Spotify is playing in your prompt, in a green box with animated equalizer bars. Works on macOS and Linux.
